original_word_pilot: Mutual one-to-one word links, no full phrase extraction.
later_complete_unit_followup: Dictionary-supplied 1–5 token noun/adj/adv units on existing evaluation pairs; shared sense/POS/number, closed union alignment with mutual anchor, larger dictionary-unit masks; contextual-role/sense errors retained; not integrated.
new_experiment: Corpus-derived source-frequency-ranked phrase inventory with every consistent target boundary variant, then separately attached complete dictionary-unit evidence. No assumption that longer or shorter target is semantically right.
portable_correction: The retained Spanish dictionary attests portátil as both portable adjective and laptop noun; exact context/sense must adjudicate any historical or new candidate. Longer computadora portátil is not automatically superior.

portátil.implication: Short noun may be complete; adjective sense also exists.

correo.implication: Short noun may be complete; ordinary postal senses also exist.

primary_dictionary_correction.old_case_labels: Retained unchanged; final per-case reassessment requires exact original contexts. Neither length alone nor lexical membership resolves source sense.
